title: Chameleon
synopsis: A space shuttle comes home with an unexplained passenger aboard, and the NASA team studying it confronts a bodiless visitor that can change its shape at will. The scientists must work out what it is and what it wants.
problem: Claimed the entity takes the form of whatever it touches; sources describe a shapeshifter that changes form at will, nothing about touch.

title: Quarantine
synopsis: A scientist frozen in suspended animation wakes some three centuries later in a peaceful, telepathic society that has turned its back on machines. Its people need his old expertise to help protect Earth from a threat approaching from space.

title: Nightmare at 30,000 Feet
synopsis: A journalist still shaken by past trauma boards an international flight and finds an MP3 player in his seat pocket, loaded with a podcast about the mysterious disappearance of the very plane he is riding on.
problem: Called him an investigative journalist; the source only says journalist (with PTSD).

title: A Traveler
synopsis: On Christmas Eve at a remote Alaskan police station, where the captain hands out a holiday pardon each year, a charming stranger who calls himself an extreme tourist turns up inside a locked holding cell.
problem: Said the stranger asks to be granted the pardon; the source does not say this.

title: Six Degrees of Freedom
synopsis: A crew bound for Mars blasts off early as nuclear war breaks out on Earth. Cut off from home and sealed in together for the long voyage, the astronauts begin turning on one another.
problem: Claimed one astronaut becomes convinced the mission is not what it seems; the source only says the crew turns on one another.

title: The Blue Scorpion
synopsis: A depressed anthropology professor facing divorce and his father's apparent suicide finds a revolver nicknamed the Blue Scorpion in his father's house, and grows fixated on it after spotting a bullet bearing his own name.
problem: Said he was recently divorced; the source says he is facing divorce. Also added that he finds the gun in his father's house.

title: Ovation
synopsis: A street singer is handed a strange medallion by a troubled pop star moments before tragedy strikes. Her career soon takes off on a wave of applause that never seems to stop.
problem: Called the object a gold coin; the source calls it a medallion.

title: Among the Untrodden
synopsis: An awkward teen transfers mid-year to an exclusive girls' boarding school, where she is bullied by the clique's queen bee, and while working on a science-fair project she becomes convinced her tormentor has psychic powers.
problem: Said the two girls bond over a shared interest in psychic powers; the source says the new girl is bullied and comes to believe her tormentor is psychic.

synopsis: Scientists at a remote Antarctic station studying melting ice shelves encounter a giant, unusually clever octopus beneath the ice, and after it claims one of the team, one researcher insists on bringing the creature into the lab.
problem: The source does not support the debate between a scientific breakthrough and a commercial opportunity; it says one researcher takes the creature to the lab after it kills a team member.

title: A Human Face
synopsis: A couple mourning their young daughter are clearing out her room when a radio warns of a cosmic flare, and soon afterwards a strange visitor turns up in their basement, offering an unexpected kind of comfort.
problem: Said the couple was preparing to move out, which the source does not state.

title: You Might Also Like
synopsis: In a pastel world of perfect consumer comfort, a suburban woman keeps losing stretches of time during the day, while she and her neighbors eagerly await the arrival of a mysterious product called the Egg.
problem: Described her as haunted by memories of an alien abduction; the source says she loses time during the day.
